new_categories.label: internal_access_element_readiness
new_categories.memory: Physical readiness of internal hold ladders, platforms, gratings or walkways is a cargo-space infrastructure service-state distinct from hatch-opening/access readiness.

new_categories.label: route_zone_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Internal-access readiness can be localized to a bounded route, level, hold or zone without retaining exact arrangements, dimensions or climb paths.

new_categories.label: physical_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-specific physical-condition confidence state can represent internal-access elements without retaining corrosion values, deformation measurements, material details or acceptance limits.

new_categories.label: support_attachment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Support or attachment confidence can degrade separately from the access element itself without retaining weld, fastening, structural-detail or load information.

new_categories.label: access_route_continuity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Route-continuity confidence can be distinct from the condition of any one ladder, platform or grating without encoding an actual movement sequence.

new_categories.label: inspection_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Inspection/verification confidence is distinct from physical readiness and can degrade without retaining methods, acceptance criteria or inspection steps.

new_categories.label: independent_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent cross-check confidence can be represented separately from shipboard self-assessment and from the physical access condition itself.

new_categories.label: alternate_access_confidence
new_categories.memory: Abstract alternate-access availability confidence can be retained without specifying climbing paths, temporary arrangements, substitutions or work-at-height actions.

new_categories.label: hold_work_availability_not_access_state_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Inspection, cargo work or hold availability is a downstream outcome and is not equivalent to internal-access element, route, support or verification state.

new_categories.label: internal_access_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Internal-access infrastructure can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-inspection and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to an element, route/zone, support/attachment, route continuity, inspection confidence or alternate-access confidence.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Inspection limitation, cargo-work restriction, hold unavailability, port rework or schedule effects do not prove a ladder, platform, grating, support or route-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_internal_access_restoration
new_categories.memory: Element correction, support recovery, route-continuity recovery, inspection, independent verification and hold release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: hatch_access_vs_internal_access_infrastructure
useful_refinements.memory: P086 hatch-cover/cargo-access service does not duplicate physical internal-access infrastructure after the cargo-space opening.

useful_refinements.label: lighting_vs_access_infrastructure
useful_refinements.memory: P111 hold lighting can affect visibility but does not establish physical ladder, platform, grating, walkway or support readiness.

useful_refinements.label: design_structures_vs_in_service_access_condition
useful_refinements.memory: P066 naval-architecture/structures design orientation does not establish in-service readiness of internal cargo-hold access elements or their bounded routes.

useful_refinements.label: generic_equipment_lifecycle_vs_delivered_access
useful_refinements.memory: P067 equipment lifecycle/support semantics do not establish delivered physical internal-access readiness or route continuity.

duplicates.label: generic_physical_asset_condition_support_verification_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic physical-condition, support-dependency and verification mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

negative_space: exact internal-access arrangements, ladder/platform/grating/walkway dimensions, materials, guarding, loads, supports, attachments and current configuration
exact corrosion, deformation, thickness, fastening, weld, inspection, testing and acceptance criteria
exact climbing, entry, work-at-height, rescue, repair, inspection, testing, isolation or emergency procedures

stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact access arrangements, dimensions, materials, loads, inspection/acceptance values, climbing/entry/work-at-height procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold internal-access infrastructure orientation and source-discovery output; not climbing, cargo-space entry, work-at-height, rescue, inspection or repair guidance and not proof of any exact arrangement, dimension, load, acceptance criterion, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
